title: SEKTION top cabinet for fridge/freezer
description: SEKTION top cabinet for fridge/freezer, white/Upplöv matte anthracite, 36x24x10" SEKTION kitchen system gives you endless possibilities to design your dream kitchen. Paired with UPPLÖV fronts in matte anthracite with integrated handle and chamfered edge, you get a modern, graphic feel.
features: To be finished with legs and plinth, sold separately.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
The hinge is adjustable in height, depth and width.
To be completed with SEKTION suspension rail for mounting the cabinet to the wall.
Requires a knob or a handle
materialAndCare: Main parts: Particleboard; Frontside/ Backside: Plastic foil (min. 90% recycled); Edge: Plastic edging, Plastic edging; Handle: Aluminum, Anodized; Frame: Particleboard, Melamine foil, Plastic edging; Back: Fiberboard, Acrylic paint; Main parts: Steel, Nickel plated; Cover cap: ABS plastic
